title: RenderingDevice.uniform_buffer_create fails after running a CompositorEffect for a couple of minutes
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.4.beta4 and 4.4.rc2

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta4.mono - Debian GNU/Linux 12 (bookworm) 12 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6900 XT (RADV NAVI21) - AMD Ryzen 9 5900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads)

### Issue description

After running a custom CompositorEffect for about 3 minutes, calling `var mat_buffer : RID =  rd.uniform_buffer_create(256, pb)` fails with "Element limit reached" and "Parameter "mem" is null".

```
E 0:03:07:565   SimplePostProcessCompositorEffect.gd:134 @ _render_callback(): Element limit reached.
  <C++ Error>   Method/function failed. Returning: RID()
  <C++ Source>  ./core/templates/rid_owner.h:133 @ _allocate_rid()
  <Stack Trace> SimplePostProcessCompositorEffect.gd:134 @ _render_callback()

E 0:03:07:565   SimplePostProcessCompositorEffect.gd:134 @ _render_callback(): Parameter "mem" is null.
  <C++ Source>  ./core/templates/rid_owner.h:296 @ initialize_rid()
  <Stack Trace> SimplePostProcessCompositorEffect.gd:134 @ _render_callback()
```

I'm guessing there's some form of a leak somewhere, but I've not been able to find a resource that tells me I need to clean anything up per frame.

Anyone have ideas of what could be wrong?

Here's relevant code I'm using:

```gdscript
func _render_callback(p_effect_callback_type: EffectCallbackType, p_render_data: RenderData) -> void:
	if rd and p_effect_callback_type == self.effect_callback_type:
		var render_scene_buffers : RenderSceneBuffersRD = p_render_data.get_render_scene_buffers()
		if render_scene_buffers:
			var size: Vector2i = render_scene_buffers.get_internal_size()
			if size.x == 0 and size.y == 0:
				return

			@warning_ignore("integer_division")
			var x_groups := (size.x - 1) / 16 + 1
			@warning_ignore("integer_division")
			var y_groups := (size.y - 1) / 16 + 1
			var z_groups := 1

			var view_count: int = render_scene_buffers.get_view_count()
			for view in view_count:
				
				var uniforms = []

				var view_transform =  p_render_data.get_render_scene_data().get_cam_transform()
				var projection_transform =  p_render_data.get_render_scene_data().get_view_projection(view)
				
				var view_matrix = [
					view_transform.basis.x.x, view_transform.basis.x.y, view_transform.basis.x.z, 0.0, 
					view_transform.basis.y.x, view_transform.basis.y.y, view_transform.basis.y.z, 0.0, 
					view_transform.basis.z.x, view_transform.basis.z.y, view_transform.basis.z.z, 0.0, 
					view_transform.origin.x, view_transform.origin.y, view_transform.origin.z, 1.0, 
				]
				
				view_transform = view_transform.inverse()
				
				var inv_view_matrix = [
					view_transform.basis.x.x, view_transform.basis.x.y, view_transform.basis.x.z, 0.0, 
					view_transform.basis.y.x, view_transform.basis.y.y, view_transform.basis.y.z, 0.0, 
					view_transform.basis.z.x, view_transform.basis.z.y, view_transform.basis.z.z, 0.0, 
					view_transform.origin.x, view_transform.origin.y, view_transform.origin.z, 1.0, 
				]
				
				var projection_matrix = [
					projection_transform.x.x, projection_transform.x.y, projection_transform.x.z, projection_transform.x.w, 
					projection_transform.y.x, projection_transform.y.y, projection_transform.y.z, projection_transform.y.w, 
					projection_transform.z.x, projection_transform.z.y, projection_transform.z.z, projection_transform.z.w, 
					projection_transform.w.x, projection_transform.w.y, projection_transform.w.z, projection_transform.w.w, 
				]
				
				projection_transform = projection_transform.inverse()
				
				var inv_projection_matrix = [
					projection_transform.x.x, projection_transform.x.y, projection_transform.x.z, projection_transform.x.w, 
					projection_transform.y.x, projection_transform.y.y, projection_transform.y.z, projection_transform.y.w, 
					projection_transform.z.x, projection_transform.z.y, projection_transform.z.z, projection_transform.z.w, 
					projection_transform.w.x, projection_transform.w.y, projection_transform.w.z, projection_transform.w.w, 
				]

				var vma = PackedFloat32Array(view_matrix).to_byte_array()
				var ivma = PackedFloat32Array(inv_view_matrix).to_byte_array()
				var pma = PackedFloat32Array(projection_matrix).to_byte_array()
				var ipma = PackedFloat32Array(inv_projection_matrix).to_byte_array()
				
				var pb = PackedByteArray()
				pb.append_array(vma)
				pb.append_array(ivma)
				pb.append_array(pma)
				pb.append_array(ipma)

				# - This is the line that fails -
				var mat_buffer : RID =  rd.uniform_buffer_create(256, pb)

				var matrices_uniform : RDUniform = RDUniform.new()
				matrices_uniform.uniform_type = RenderingDevice.UNIFORM_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER
				matrices_uniform.binding = 2
				matrices_uniform.add_id(mat_buffer)
				uniforms.append(matrices_uniform)
				
				if use_color:
					# Get the RID for our color image, we will be reading from and writing to it.
					var input_image: RID = render_scene_buffers.get_color_layer(view)
					# Create a uniform set, this will be cached, the cache will be cleared if our viewports configuration is changed.
					var uniform := RDUniform.new()
					uniform.uniform_type = RenderingDevice.UNIFORM_TYPE_IMAGE
					uniform.binding = color_binding
					uniform.add_id(input_image)
					uniforms.append(uniform)
				if use_depth:
					var input_image: RID = render_scene_buffers.get_depth_layer(view)
					var uniform := RDUniform.new()
					uniform.uniform_type = RenderingDevice.UNIFORM_TYPE_SAMPLER_WITH_TEXTURE
					uniform.binding = depth_binding
					uniform.add_id(nearest_sampler)
					uniform.add_id(input_image)
					uniforms.append(uniform)

				if uniforms.is_empty():
					push_error("No uniforms set")
					self.enabled = false
					break

				var uniform_set := UniformSetCacheRD.get_cache(shader, 0, uniforms)

				var camera_position = p_render_data.get_render_scene_data().get_view_eye_offset(view)

				# Create push constant.
				# Must be aligned to 16 bytes and be in the same order as defined in the shader.
				var push_constant := PackedFloat32Array([
					size.x,
					size.y,
					0.0, # padding
					0.0, # padding
					camera_position[0],
					camera_position[1],
					camera_position[2],
					1.0,
				])

				# Run our compute shader.
				var compute_list := rd.compute_list_begin()
				rd.compute_list_bind_compute_pipeline(compute_list, pipeline)
				rd.compute_list_bind_uniform_set(compute_list, uniform_set, 0)
				rd.compute_list_set_push_constant(compute_list, push_constant.to_byte_array(), push_constant.size() * 4)
				rd.compute_list_dispatch(compute_list, x_groups, y_groups, z_groups)
				rd.compute_list_end()
```

### Steps to reproduce

Create a uniform buffer of 256 bytes once per frame for around 3-4 minutes

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[UniformBufferProblems.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19028225/UniformBufferProblems.zip)
